name: Boston, MA
subtitle: From Union Oyster House to James Beard winners
items: Union Oyster House (America's oldest restaurant, since 1826)
Neptune Oyster (North End, legendary lobster roll — get there early)
Pizzeria Regina (North End, since 1926 — NY-style, old school)
Mike's Pastry (North End, cannoli pilgrimage)
No. 9 Park (Barbara Lynch, Beacon Hill fine dining)
Menton (Barbara Lynch, South End — the splurge)
Toro (Ken Oringer, South End, Spanish tapas)
Myers + Chang (Joanne Chang, South End, Asian-American)
Flour Bakery (Joanne Chang — multiple locations, sticky buns)
Oleana (Ana Sortun, Cambridge, Middle Eastern)
Row 34 (Fort Point, craft beer + oysters)
Eastern Standard (Kenmore, always great)
Craigie on Main (Cambridge, nose-to-tail, craft cocktails)
Island Creek Oyster Bar (Kenmore, 3-story oyster bar)
Waypoint (Cambridge, pasta + wood-fired)
Harvest (Cambridge, Harvard Square, New England seasonal)
Sarma (Somerville, Ana Sortun's meze)
The Smoke Shop (Cambridge, BBQ)
Legal Sea Foods (controversial but iconic — the original)
Giacomo's Ristorante (North End, cash only, worth the wait)
O Ya (Japanese omakase, one of the best in the US)
